name: OrbThrow
_intent: Ending the awakening: from OrbAwaken a short dip (knees and arms load, 0-0.35 s), then a full-body throw of the orb straight up and a little forward: legs extend onto the toes, arms whip up and forward to full extension at Release, hands flick open; a held reach, then settle into TrainOrb's first frame.
_reference: overhead full-body throw; Release at frame 15 (0.5000 s)

keyframes._note: RELEASE: arms at full extension up and forward, hands flick open
